RUNTIME: every iteration calls a hosted foundation model API -- OpenAI (default client/model gpt-4o-2024-05-13 and gpt-4-turbo-2024-04-09 per configs/omni_epic.yaml), or Anthropic / Google generativeai per omni_epic/core/fm.py FM._create_client; embeddings via OpenAI text-embedding-3-small (rag_utils.get_openai_embeddings, embedding_method: openai default)

RUNTIME (optional embedding methods): HuggingFace model downloads Salesforce/codet5p-110m-embedding, mixedbread-ai/mxbai-embed-large-v1, BERT, nomic, mistral via transformers/sentence_transformers (rag_utils.py)
RUNTIME (optional): wandb logging when dreamer config wandb: True
entry_points: main_omni_epic.py main (hydra entry, configs/omni_epic.yaml; the open-ended outer loop: for each of config.iterations, pick a task description -- seeded from robot_dict[robot]['task_descs_init'] for the first iterations, else generated by the FM from archive examples chosen by embedding similarity -- generate environment code, repair compile errors, judge interestingness, train DreamerV3, detect success, and sort the env file into archive_codepaths / archive_failedgens / archive_failedint / archive_failedtrain; appends archive.jsonl and metadata.json each iteration)
main_omni_epic.py init_archive (loads archive lists from a previous archive.jsonl checkpoint)

omni_epic/core/fm.py FM (wraps OpenAI / anthropic / google.generativeai chat clients; methods query_env_code, reflect_error, iterate_on_errors (write env_<i>.py, test_env_halts with 10s timeout, test_env, on failure ask the FM to reflect on the traceback up to iteration_max times), get_next_task_desc, query_interestingness (FM compares the candidate env code against the N most similar archived codes and returns an is_interesting boolean), query_success_with_vision, reflect_task / reflect_task_with_vision)

omni_epic/core/prompts/*.py (system/user prompt templates: query_env_code, query_next_task_desc, query_next_task_desc_no_moi, query_interestingness, query_success, reflect_error, reflect_task, reflect_task_with_vision)
rag_utils.py get_similar_codepaths / get_embeddings (embeds env source files and ranks by cosine distance; embedding_method openai|codet5|mxbai|bert|nomic|mistral)

omni_epic/envs/__init__.py test_env / test_env_halts / env_run_all (validation harness for generated Env code: checks observation types, collisions, that step does not terminate/succeed immediately, 100 zero-action steps for object collisions/robot falling, and a multiprocessing timeout)

omni_epic/envs/base.py Env(gym.Env) and omni_epic/robots/{ant,humanoid,r2d2}.py (PyBullet robot/env base classes that generated code subclasses: step() applies action, steps the bullet simulation, sums task rewards + robot rewards; get_task_rewards/get_terminated/get_truncated/get_success are abstract for the FM to write)

main_dreamer.py main_dreamer (hydra entry, configs/dreamer/dreamer_xxs.yaml; builds embodied PyBullet env from config.env.path, Replay, dreamerv3.Agent, and calls embodied.run.train; run.steps default 2097152, jax.platform gpu)
game/backend/app.py (Flask + SocketIO backend for the human-playable game; frontend in game/frontend, Next.js)
example_input: configs/omni_epic.yaml defaults (robot: r2d2, iterations: 50, error_max_iterations: 5, enable_moi: True, enable_sd: True, train_agent: True, embedding_method: openai, FM client openai model gpt-4o-2024-05-13, temperature 0) plus seeded natural-language task descriptions in omni_epic/robots/__init__.py robot_dict[robot]['task_descs_init'] and few-shot example env files omni_epic/envs/<robot>/*.py; requires OPENAI_API_KEY in the environment
example_output: Per code (README gives no sample output): a run directory ./output/omni_epic/<timestamp>/ containing task_<i>/env_<gen>.py (FM-generated PyBullet environment code), task_<i>/render.mp4 and render3p.mp4, task_<i>/metadata.json, task_<i>/dreamer/ (DreamerV3 logdir with checkpoint.ckpt, metrics.jsonl, eval renders), and an appended archive.jsonl with keys codepaths / failedgens / failedint / failedtrain
runtime_native_deps: NVIDIA GPU + CUDA 12 (requirements: jax[cuda12_pip]; dreamer config jax.platform: gpu; apptainer shell --nv; EGL vendor json apptainer/10_nvidia.json for headless rendering)

JAX/flax/optax + tensorflow_probability (vendored DreamerV3), tensorflow-cpu (embodied), torch (embeddings / optional)
ffmpeg, libcairo2-dev, libpango1.0-dev (container.def apt installs; manim/mediapy/moviepy)
Hosted LLM/VLM API access (OpenAI / Anthropic / Google) -- mandatory for the main loop
Node.js/bun for the optional game frontend

built_to: README: a system 'that endlessly create[s] learnable and interesting environments, further propelling the development of self-improving AI systems and AI-Generating Algorithms' -- Open-endedness via Models of human Notions of Interestingness with Environments Programmed in Code.
pressure: NOT_FOUND_AT_PIN as an explicit statement (README has no motivation paragraph beyond the one-sentence description); the code and config names imply the pressure: generating tasks that are simultaneously learnable (compilable, trainable by DreamerV3, success-detectable) and interesting (judged by a foundation model against the archive) rather than random or repetitive.
success_means: README does not state metrics; per code, per-task success is DreamerV3 training followed by a success detector (get_task_success_from_folder majority vote over eval episodes, or a VLM judging concatenated render frames when success_detector.use_vision), and the archive growth (archive_codepaths vs failedgens/failedint/failedtrain in archive.jsonl); analysis/ has plot_annecs.py, plot_diversity.py, plot_envgen_success.py, plot_percentlearned.py suggesting ANNECS, diversity, env-generation success and percent-learned metrics.
main_loop_one_sentence: main_omni_epic.main iterates config.iterations times: it picks a seeded task description or asks a foundation model for the next task given embedding-similar archived and failed environment codes, asks the FM to write a PyBullet gym Env subclass and repairs it via reflect_error until test_env passes (or gives up after error_max_iterations), asks the FM whether the new environment is interesting relative to its nearest archived neighbours, trains a DreamerV3 agent (warm-started from the most similar archived task's checkpoint), checks success from eval files or a VLM, and appends the env path to the success archive or to one of three failure archives (with one retry via reflect_task when training fails).
behavioral_entry_point: main_omni_epic.py:main (outer loop policy: example selection via taskgen_choose_probs and get_similar_codepaths, archive gating); omni_epic/core/fm.py:FM.get_next_task_desc / query_interestingness / iterate_on_errors (FM query behaviour); omni_epic/core/prompts/*.py (prompt text); configs/omni_epic.yaml (model choices, enable_moi/enable_sd/train_agent switches); omni_epic/envs/__init__.py:test_env (environment validity criteria)
